spans.s:
युष्टग्राम युष्ट-ग्राम, अस्, m., N. of a
village.

युष्मद् युष्मद्, a form derived from युष्-
मत्, abl. pl. of the pronominal base 4. यु, and
serving for the base of the 2nd personal pronoun in
the plural number and at the beginning of some
compounds; the actual base, however, in most of
the plural cases is युष्म, which is also found in a
few compounds, cf. युष्मा-दत्त below; the fol-
lowing forms are found, यूयम्, nom. pl. you;
युष्मान्, acc. you; युष्माभिस्, inst. by you;
युष्मभ्यम्, dat. to you; युष्मत् or युष्मत्-
तस्, abl. from you; युष्माकम्, gen. of you, (in
Ved. the final nasal may be dropped, e. g. युष्मा-
कैक for युष्माकम् एक); युष्मासु (Ved. also
युष्मे), loc. in you, cf. Ṛg-veda

;
[cf. Zend yūs; Gr. ὑμεῖς, Æol. ὔμμες (fr. ὔσμες);
Goth. and Lith. ju-s.]
—युष्मद्-अर्थम्, ind.
for you, on your account.
—युष्मद्-आयत्त, अस्,
आ, अम्, dependent upon you, at your disposal.
—युष्मद्-वाच्य, अम्, n. (in gram.) the second
person.
—युष्मद्-विध, अस्, आ, अम्, of your kind
or sort, like you.
—युष्मा-दत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
given or bestowed by you; [cf. युवा-दत्त.]
—युष्मा-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, or युष्मा-दृश, अस्, ई,
अम्, like you, similar to you, resembling you, one
such as you; [cf. मादृश्, त्वा-दृश्.]
—युष्मा-
नीत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. led or accompanied by you.
—युष्मा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. belonging to you.
—युष्मेषित (˚मा-इष्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. excited
or instigated by you.
—युष्मोत (˚मा-ऊत), अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. protected or loved by you.

युष्मदीय, अस्, आ, अम्, your, yours, your own,
belonging to you.

युष्मयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. seeking you,
addressed to you, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda

युष्माक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. your, yours; [cf.
युष्माक under युष्मद्.]

यूष् यूष् [cf. rt. जूष्], cl. 1. P. यूषति,
&c., to injure, hurt, wound; to kill; [cf.
Slav. juchŭ.]

यूष यूष, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be con-
nected with rt. यूष् above; cf. जूष), soup, broth,
pease-soup, the water in which pulse of various kinds
has been boiled; (अस्), m. the Indian mulberry tree;
[cf. probably Gr. ζωμός, ζύθος; Lat. jus; Slav.
jucha.]

यूषन्, a form optionally substituted for यूष
in all the cases except Nom. Voc. sing. du. pl., Acc.
sing. du. (e. g. Acc. pl. यूषान् or यूष्णः, Inst.
sing. यूषेण or यूष्णा, du. यूषाभ्याम् or यू-
षभ्याम्, &c.).
